dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: I used to use my rest time to review documents, but... that was when we were at war.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: Given that there's no time pressure here, I prefer to take things at a slower pace, and make sure to rest and recover my energy in between battles.

dialogues.speaker: Sangonomiya Kokomi
dialogues.text: After all, exhaustion is one of the deadliest enemies you can encounter on the battlefield.
